title: Figure 21. Simplistic rendering of a DNA logic gate (AND and AND-AND-NOT gates)
description: Illustrated infographic on a dark blue background explaining how deoxyribozymes with stem-loop controllers form logic gates. An "AND Gate" section shows the enzyme with blue and purple stem-loops and a truth table of input combinations, and an "AND-AND-NOT Gate" section adds a yellow inhibitory loop with an eight-row truth table where a red glowing output marks the active state. Captioned "Figure 21. Simplistic rendering of a DNA logic gate."
